requirements.text: Notifications are created only by trusted server code, never through a public endpoint
The inbox lists newest first with cursor pages that have no gaps or repeats
Unread counts, mark read, mark all read and archive work
Users see and change only their own notifications within their tenant
A repeated event for the same recipient does not create a duplicate notification
Links, titles and attached data are validated so notifications cannot carry unsafe links or unbounded data
Items past retention and beyond a per-user cap are pruned
A bell or inbox UI shows the unread badge and items and is keyboard accessible

evidence.name: HTTP adapter: 401, origin check, publish not exposed
publish and list: newest first, opaque cursor pages without gaps or repeats
unread counts, markRead, markAllRead with before, and archive
a repeated dedupeKey returns the existing item
publish validation: unsafe links, titles and data are rejected
prune drops items past retention and the oldest beyond maxPerUser

implementations.notes: Server only: no UI and no SQL store (the SQL shape is documented)
